source: TWSE OpenAPI v1 t187ap07_L_ci + repository market snapshot

methodology.safetyScore: 30% current ratio percentile + 25% inverse debt ratio + 20% equity ratio + 15% working-capital/assets + 10% retained-earnings/equity. P/B is shown separately and is not part of safety score.
methodology.caution: 流動資產不等於可立即變現現金。營建業通常含房地/在建存貨；本版不把流動資產誤標為存貨。
methodology.nextLayer: 上述細項需由 MOPS/XBRL 財報科目深化後再做去化、預售覆蓋與淨負債判讀。
